description: The signed-in couple's own wedding events on Zola: add 1 event that guests see on the wedding website, for example the ceremony, the reception, a welcome party or a brunch. Give the name, the type, the day and the start time. The day and the times are the local clock time at the place of the event, as the couple says them: never convert them to another time zone. Ask the couple for the start time when the couple does not say it. By default, as on zola.com, every guest sees the event, Zola invites each invited guest group to it, and guests can RSVP: give on_website false for an event that only some guests attend, for example a rehearsal dinner, then invite guest groups to it with zola_update_my_guest (invite_to_event_ids) or on the guest list of zola.com. If the website is published, guests see the event at once. Zola sends no message to the guests. No tool removes an event, and Zola can refuse to remove an event on zola.com after a guest answers its RSVP. Status possible_duplicate: the wedding has an event with this name on this day, and Zola added nothing. To change it, use zola_update_my_wedding_event. If the couple wants a second event, give the match_id of each match in ignore_match_ids. A call without confirm_token changes nothing: it returns a preview with a confirm_token. Show the preview to the couple. Call again with the same arguments and the confirm_token only after the couple says yes. Requires Zola sign-in (account:write).

address1.description: The street address of the venue

address2.description: The second line of the street address, for example a suite

collects_rsvps.description: True when guests can RSVP to the event on the website. Default true

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token of the preview. Give it only after the couple said yes to that preview, with the same arguments

country_code.description: The country of the venue, 2 letters, for example US. US when the call gives an address or a city and no country

date.description: The day of the event, YYYY-MM-DD, at the place of the event

end_time.description: The end time, HH:MM in 24 hours, the local clock time at the place of the event. An end time before the start is on the next day. Not the start time

ignore_match_ids.description: The match_id of each event of a possible_duplicate preview, when the couple says that the couple wants a second event with this name on this day

name.description: The name of the event that guests see, for example "Welcome Party"

note.description: The note for guests on the website

on_website.description: The on_website of zola_list_my_wedding_events. Default true, as on zola.com: every guest sees the event on the website, and Zola invites every invited guest group to it. False: only the guests that the couple invites to the event see it, for example a rehearsal dinner

postal_code.description: The postal code of the venue

start_time.description: The start time, HH:MM in 24 hours, the local clock time at the place of the event, as the couple says it. Never convert it. Ask the couple when the couple does not say it

state_province.description: The state or province of the venue, for example TX

type.description: The type of the event. other for an event that is not in the list

name: zola_add_my_wedding_event

outputSchema.description: The preview or the result of an event added to the wedding of the signed-in couple

cannot_undo.description: What the change removes and Zola cannot restore

changed.description: True only when this call changed the wedding events

confirm_token.description: Give it to zola_add_my_wedding_event with the same arguments, only after the couple says yes

expires_at.description: The end of the validity of confirm_token, ISO 8601 UTC

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

records.description: The new events with a change, in the order of the call

removal.description: True when the change removes or overwrites a value

id.description: The id of the record, as zola_list_my_wedding_events gives it

matches.description: With possible_duplicate: the records that look like the new one

id.description: Give it in ignore_match_ids when the couple wants the new record beside this one

name.description: The record, as the couple knows it

version.description: The version of the record as this call read it

replayed.description: True when this is the stored result of an earlier call with the same confirm_token

status.description: preview: nothing changed, confirm_token makes the change. nothing_to_change: nothing to change, no confirm_token. done: changed. draft_changed: nothing changed, a new preview. record_changed: nothing changed, read again

title: Add My Wedding Event
